newsitem.title: USA: Medallion Financial to offer 3.5 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT 12/4]
newsitem.headline: Medallion Financial to offer 3.5 mln shrs. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT 12/4]

text.p: Medallion Financial Corp Friday said it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 3.5 million shares in an public offering. (Corrects from "initial public offering").
Furman Selz, Bear Stearns, & Co. Inc., Everen Securities, Inc. and J.C. Bradford & Co. are the managing underwriters of the offering, the company said.
Medallion Financial is a specialty finance company that services loans made to finance the purchase of taxicab medallions and related assets.
